end.say: Welcome home, investigator. Whatever happens next... nice to have someone who's seen the whole sky.

back.say: You're back! And in one piece! So... is it true what the relays are saying? A SECOND sun?

options.label: True
options.text: It's true. The question is who it rises for.

options.label: Quiet
options.text: You'll know when the sky tells you.

quiet.say: Ugh, you're as cryptic as a Mercurial now. Fine. First round of bits is on the Capitol anyway — for making it back.

rises.say: Huh. Two suns. Twice the flares, twice the hats. ...I should start knitting.
